Nadia is in #strategic-pod, so she can see this thread.

Nadia, Gideon landed on **280 seats** for Vantorre Group in his July 1 update in #strategic-pod. He first posted 300. Minutes later he corrected it, saying the 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from their May rollout. 280 is the active seat count on the production roster as of July 1. Ruth also asked him to update the Q3 QBR deck to the corrected number.
